summary: RPM controller logs live in /var/log/tower/ and /var/log/supervisor/. /var/log/tower holds tower.log (runtime errors), callback_receiver.log, dispatcher.log, job_lifecycle.log (why jobs are blocked), management_playbooks.log, rsyslog.err, task_system.log, RBAC and system tracking migration logs and wsbroadcast.log.
questions: Which log shows why a job is blocked?
Where are rsyslog authentication errors logged?
